goal: Measure scene writing gains from narrative selection and broader reading at fixed model size and token budget.
initialization: Fresh paired weights from subword_model.create; same seed in each comparison

training.sampling: Frozen record order, cyclic target indices from zero, previous token as input; contexts may cross record and stream boundaries
training.tail: Pad final context and mask excess targets; count only scored targets
training.schedule: Cosine to zero after warmup over the full comparison budget
training.checkpoint_selection: Lowest shared selection bits per byte at update 200 and each following multiple, plus final update; earliest wins ties
training.precision: float32 on CPU; bfloat16 autocast on CUDA; same device and precision for paired arms

evaluation.shared_source: Frozen A validation, protected by B/C delivery audit
evaluation.selection: 64 windows in the first half, 256 scored targets per window
evaluation.outcome: 256 windows in the second half, read after both arms finish

human_review.reviewer: One designated reviewer completes every case once per comparison; revisions replace earlier votes
human_review.denominator: All 200 cases; skip is unresolved and contributes zero wins
human_review.uncertainty: Report a Wilson interval on decisive choices; conditional descriptive interval for this reviewer and prompt set
human_review.rubric: Prefer the continuation with stable characters, sensible event order, clear dialogue, readable prose and less looping. Skip a tie or an unclear choice.

evaluation.repetition: Report repeated four-gram excess per continuation; candidate mean may exceed control by at most 0.01
evaluation.annotation_use: Delivered scene annotations support separate diagnostics; shared protected validation supplies the primary comparison
evaluation.test_policy: Test content stays sealed during this campaign

decision.pilot: Both arms complete, finite scores, at least 2% lower outcome bits per byte, review thresholds pass, and repetition bound passes
decision.replication: Seeds 17 and 29 use the same frozen contract after a passing pilot; report each seed and require both to pass the numerical gates
decision.scope: Narrative continuation on the protected evaluation set; model promotion is a later decision
